invariants.rationale: The aggregation returns a non-null value as reduce starts with a non-null zeroValue and applies pure functions.
seqOp must be non-null to be used as a function reference in reduce.
combOp must be non-null for the reduce call in stream.
data is dereferenced for collectAsList, so it must not be null.
zeroValue is used as the identity in reduce and must be non-null.
